name: PID Controller
author: rezajamesahmed
description: A PID controller simulator: tune the KP, KI and KD gains and watch the dial settle on the set point. X to run, Z to reset, arrows to tune.

descriptions.en: A PID controller simulator: tune the KP, KI and KD gains and watch the dial settle on the set point. X to run, Z to reset, arrows to tune.
descriptions.it: Un simulatore di controllore PID: regola i guadagni KP, KI e KD e guarda il quadrante raggiungere il valore obiettivo. X avvia, Z azzera, frecce per regolare.
